name.en-US: Council of Basel, Ferrara and Florence (1431–1445)
name.pt-BR: Concílio de Basileia, Ferrara e Florença (1431–1445)

description.la: Documenta concilii Basiliensis, Ferrariensis, Florentini et Romani (1431–1445): decreta unionis cum Graecis (Laetentur caeli), Armenis (Exultate Deo), Iacobitis (Cantate Domino).
description.en-US: The documents of the seventeenth ecumenical council, which moved from Basel to Ferrara and Florence (1431–1445) and reunited the Greeks, Armenians and Copts with Rome: Laetentur caeli, Exultate Deo, Cantate Domino. Latin text.
description.pt-BR: Os documentos do décimo sétimo concílio ecumênico, que passou de Basileia a Ferrara e Florença (1431–1445) e uniu gregos, armênios e coptas a Roma: Laetentur caeli, Exultate Deo, Cantate Domino.

la.editor: Conciliorum Oecumenicorum Decreta (Bologna 1962), via Latin Wikisource / Documenta Catholica Omnia

sources.edition: Latin Wikisource, Concilii Basiliensis Documenta, the text of Conciliorum Oecumenicorum Decreta (Bologna 1962) as circulated by Documenta Catholica Omnia. Wikitext fetched through action=raw.
sources.description: Complete as transcribed. The digitisation has its punctuation largely stripped, no capitals at the start of sentences, lowercase deus/dominus, and no canon numbers; the text is left as transcribed, with line breaks kept as paragraph breaks, the digitisation's split enclitics rejoined and bracketed headings turned into markdown headings. No public-domain English translation of this text has been imported yet.
sources.tierEvidence: Medieval documents; the digitisation derives from the Library of Latin Texts / COD text (a critical edition of 1962/1973), which carries at most a neighbouring right that has run out and is freely redistributed by Wikisource and Documenta Catholica Omnia.
